_provenance.method: Grouped by ANZSCO code from occupation-search.csv (an occupation can have one row per WASMOL/Graduate stream it qualifies under); subclass190/491 is the union of v190/v491 across its rows. CAVEAT: every row in this source file has Priority Occupation=Yes -- this appears to be a PRIORITY-OCCUPATIONS SEARCH EXPORT, not confirmed to be WA's complete WASMOL Schedule 1/2 + Graduate occupation lists (which may include non-priority occupations this file doesn't cover). A NOT_ON_LIST result for WA means 'not in this priority-occupations export', not 'confirmed excluded from WA's full occupation lists'.
